name: Decorated Cave of Pont d’Arc, known as Grotte Chauvet-Pont d’Arc, Ardèche
description: Hidden in a limestone cliff above the Ardèche gorges in southern France, this cave holds some of the oldest and best-preserved paintings ever found, made roughly 30,000 to 32,000 years ago. A rockfall sealed it for around 20,000 years until its rediscovery in 1994. Over 1,000 images of lions, mammoths, rhinos and bears show shading and a sense of movement, alongside ancient footprints.
